summary: The weekday header row was separated from the first week by the grid's 4px gap, where both artboards draw `margin-bottom: var(--ui-space-md)` — 12px — on that row (DZO-0 and JNV-0). Shipped since Calendar did, invisible to every gate: the utilities all resolved, the contrast was right, and the visual baseline recorded the defect as the reference. Found by measuring the gap in Chromium while reviewing the month/year selects, because the missing 8px was also what made a select panel resize the card by 9px on open. Fixed with mb-sm on the weekday CELLS — the row is display:contents, so a margin on the row itself would do nothing — giving 4 + 8 = 12. The card is 8px taller and both baselines were re-recorded and looked at.
